snippet.title: BAPTISTE | Horror Game Awards 2025 WORLD PREMIERE
snippet.description:
Step into the unsettling world of Baptiste, a story‑driven psychological horror game where every shadow hides a secret and every sound could be your last. After a devastating family tragedy, Sara and her son Tom move to Jagged Shore Cliff in the United Kingdom, hoping for a fresh start, but their new home conceals a sinister glass cabinet and a cursed doll that will push their sanity to the edge.​

Explore a dark, atmospheric mansion, uncover disturbing mysteries, and experience a narrative that blurs the line between reality and nightmare as Tom confronts his fears and the malevolent presence stalking the house. With immersive sound design, tense exploration, and a constant sense of dread, Baptiste is crafted for fans of slow‑burn psychological horror and story‑rich single‑player experiences.​

Wishlist Baptiste now and support the game on your favorite platform:​

Steam (PC): https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922250/Baptiste/​

PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10013181​​

Xbox Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/baptiste/9p5v6jd1g30q ---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://www.thehorrorgameawards.com/store
